#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create an ICS calendar entry for a project kickoff meeting.

Meeting: next Monday, 10:00 AM local time, 2 hours (10:00 - 12:00).
"""
import datetime
import os
import re
import uuid

OUTPUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "project_kickoff.ics")


def next_monday(today=None):
    """Return the Monday of next week (strictly after today)."""
    today = today or datetime.date.today()
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday == 0
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def detect_timezone():
    """Best-effort IANA timezone detection from the local system."""
    candidates = []
    try:
        with open("/etc/timezone", "r") as f:
            candidates.append(f.read().strip())
    except (OSError, IOError):
        pass
    try:
        link = os.path.realpath("/etc/localtime")
        if link.startswith("/usr/share/zoneinfo/"):
            candidates.append(link[len("/usr/share/zoneinfo/"):])
    except OSError:
        pass
    for tz in candidates:
        # Accept common IANA zone names; skip POSIX-style/relative values.
        if tz and not tz.startswith("..") and re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_+-]+/[A-Za-z_+-]+(/[A-Za-z_+-]+)?$", tz):
            return tz
    return "UTC"


def build_ics(meeting_date, tz_name, uid):
    now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    start_local = datetime.datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 10, 0)
    end_local = start_local + datetime.timedelta(hours=2)

    dtstamp = now_utc.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    dtstart = start_local.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    dtend = end_local.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
        f"DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{dtstart}",
        f"DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{dtend}",
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting - agenda, goals, roles, and timeline will be reviewed.",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting starts in 15 minutes",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    return "\r\n".join(lines).encode("utf-8")


def validate_ics(data):
    """Validate required structure of the generated ICS."""
    text = data.decode("utf-8")
    checks = {
        "calendar begin": "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in text,
        "calendar end": text.rstrip().endswith("END:VCALENDAR"),
        "event begin": "BEGIN:VEVENT" in text,
        "event end": "END:VEVENT" in text,
        "version": "VERSION:2.0" in text,
        "prodid": "PRODID:" in text,
        "uid": "UID:" in text,
        "dtstamp": "DTSTAMP:" in text,
        "dtstart": "DTSTART" in text,
        "dtend": "DTEND" in text,
        "summary": "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting" in text,
        "alarm": "BEGIN:VALARM" in text and "END:VALARM" in text,
    }
    failed = [name for name, ok in checks.items() if not ok]
    if failed:
        raise ValueError(f"Validation failed for: {', '.join(failed)}")

    m_start = re.search(r"DTSTART;TZID=([^:]+):(\d{8}T\d{6})", text)
    m_end = re.search(r"DTEND;TZID=([^:]+):(\d{8}T\d{6})", text)
    if not (m_start and m_end):
        raise ValueError("Could not parse DTSTART/DTEND")
    start = datetime.datetime.strptime(m_start.group(2), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    end = datetime.datetime.strptime(m_end.group(2), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    if end <= start:
        raise ValueError("DTEND must be after DTSTART")
    if (end - start) != datetime.timedelta(hours=2):
        raise ValueError("Meeting duration must be 2 hours")
    return m_start.group(2), m_end.group(2)


def main():
    meeting_date = next_monday()
    tz_name = detect_timezone()
    uid = f"project-kickoff-{uuid.uuid4()}@example.com"
    data = build_ics(meeting_date, tz_name, uid)

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(data)

    start_s, end_s = validate_ics(data)
    print(f"Created: {OUTPUT}")
    print(f"Summary : Project Kickoff Meeting")
    print(f"Date    : {meeting_date.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')}")
    print(f"Start   : {start_s} ({tz_name})")
    print(f"End     : {end_s} ({tz_name})")
    print(f"Duration: 2 hours")
    print(f"Reminder: 15 minutes before")
    print("Validation: OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
